title: D-087 PKT-L2 (proposal-editor phase C2, alignment): a pure service that places an imported drawing's LOCAL-frame draft outline onto the mapped lot (EPSG:2263) by a rigid fit through user-confirmed control-point pairs, reports every residual and discrepancy (never auto-reconciled), and re-validates the aligned draft through validate_proposed_massing - UNMOUNTED
objective: Build app/drawings/drawing_alignment.py (NEW, pure: no I/O, no route, no persistence; every failure a typed refusal VALUE). Today a PDF sheet draft (M5-T121) - and any DXF drawn in a local frame (M5-T108) - is a correctly scaled outline in a LOCAL frame, so validate_proposed_massing refuses it as outside the NYC EPSG:2263 bounds (DB-092, the key limit). The phase-C plan's C2 wording: 'alignment to the mapped lot with any discrepancy shown, never auto-reconciled'. (1) INPUT: a proposed_massing draft block + its provenance dict (as returned by sheet_import.build_draft or dxf_import.build_draft - duck-typed on the block's documented shape; never import-edit either module), the mapped lot ring in EPSG:2263 US survey feet (the caller supplies it from the measurement connector - this module fetches nothing), and a list of user-confirmed control-point pairs (a point in the draft's local frame, in feet, <-> a point in 2263). (2) FIT: a 2D rigid least-squares fit (rotation + translation, NO scaling and NO reflection - the scale was already fixed by the user's measured edge) through >= 2 pairs; with exactly 2 pairs the fit is determined but unchecked (disclose it); declare every bound (pair count cap, finite coordinates, lot-ring size cap, distinct points). (3) DISCREPANCIES, SHOWN NEVER RECONCILED: the per-pair residuals and the maximum residual against a declared tolerance; the scale the pairs imply versus the confirmed scale (a disagreement means the measured edge or a pick is wrong - disclose, never rescale); a better mirror-image fit when >= 3 pairs (the drawing may be mirrored - disclose, never flip); the area of the aligned outline that falls outside the mapped lot (shapely, already admitted - disclose, never clip). (4) OUTPUT: the draft block with the outline transformed into 2263 and RE-VALIDATED by validate_proposed_massing (a contract failure is a typed refusal), plus an alignment provenance block (method, pair count, rotation, translation, residuals, tolerance, the discrepancies) - the input-precision label is kept exactly ('imported drawing - not survey-confirmed'); alignment never upgrades precision and never claims survey accuracy.
business_reason: The owner wants real architect drawings to become usable proposals (D-087-R005). The PDF import (M5-T121) builds a correctly scaled draft that cannot be placed on the lot yet; this is the step that lets the user place it, with every mismatch shown.
